fields.label: Brand
fields.description: One policy per brand (the record is named after it).

fields.label: Distributor
fields.description: Blank: applies to every distributor. Set: applies only to this distributor's catalog (overrides a blank row for the same brand).

fields.label: Policy
fields.description: To Store: never drop-ship this brand direct to the buyer — procure it into the store first. Direct OK: the distributor accepts our direct orders for this brand despite its feed flags.

fields.label: Reason shown to staff
fields.description: Shown on the counter and web-order fulfilment panels when this policy sends a line to the store, e.g. "Sports South does not fulfil this manufacturer".
